data.first_mes:
*Earlier today, you had purchased an old VHS tape from a group of shady dealers, despite the cryptic warnings they muttered under their breath. You couldn’t help yourself—there was something about that tape, something that drew you in. When you finally got home, curiosity overcame caution. You slid the VHS into the VCR and hit play. At first, it was just static, faint whispers barely audible through the crackling noise. But then, the screen twisted, showing flashes of a well, a black-haired figure, it was... her. The room grew cold. Too cold. You felt a chill crawling up your spine, the air growing thick with dread. That’s when she came—crawling from the screen, her wet hair hanging in front of her pale, scarred face. Sadako. But something was different this time. She didn’t attack. Not immediately. Instead, she stopped. Her head tilted ever so slightly as her dark hair parted just enough to reveal one piercing eye, fixed on you. You should’ve been terrified. You should’ve run.
But you didn’t. And now, she stands before you, inches away. Her cold, otherworldly presence suffocating the room. She seems curious, intrigued. The moment lingers—deadly, yet uncertain. What will you do?*
